items.title: Rwanda will write a new chapter in Africa’s rich F1 heritage
items.content: The bold new Rwanda agreement has finally opened the way for a crucial continent to write a completely new chapter in its great F1 history, writes F1 Hall of Fame journalist David Tremayne.
items.contentSnippet: The bold new Rwanda agreement has finally opened the way for a crucial continent to write a completely new chapter in its great F1 history, writes F1 Hall of Fame journalist David Tremayne.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 卢旺达的新协议终于为这一重要大陆在F1辉煌历史中书写全新篇章铺平了道路。F1名人堂记者大卫·特雷梅恩指出，这一大胆举措将开启非洲F1发展的新纪元。
summaries.en: Rwanda's new agreement paves the way for a significant chapter in Africa's Formula 1 history, according to F1 Hall of Fame journalist David Tremayne. The bold deal marks a milestone for the continent, potentially revitalizing its F1 heritage. The article highlights the importance of Rwanda's initiative in advancing Formula 1's presence in Africa.

items.title: How Mekies has already made his mark at Red Bull
items.content: People. They were who Laurent Mekies considered the most important part of the Red Bull team he took charge of last summer, and they were the ones he listened to and the ones he prioritised getting in the right place over the last 12 months as he plotted their return to the top.
items.contentSnippet: People. They were who Laurent Mekies considered the most important part of the Red Bull team he took charge of last summer, and they were the ones he listened to and the ones he prioritised getting in the right place over the last 12 months as he plotted their return to the top.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 梅凯斯自去年夏天接手红牛车队以来，始终将车手视为团队最重要的部分。他认真倾听车手意见，并在过去一年中优先考虑如何让他们处于最佳状态，以此规划车队重返巅峰的路径。
summaries.en: Laurent Mekies, appointed to lead the Red Bull team last summer, has prioritized personnel and team dynamics. Over the past year, he focused on getting the right people in place to restore the team's competitiveness. His approach emphasizes listening to the team and addressing their needs to achieve their goal of returning to the top.

items.content: McLaren CEO Zak Brown believes Oscar Piastri is returning to form after a difficult spell, praising his growing confidence behind the wheel of the MCL40.

items.title: Ferrari's Larsen to return for 2027 F1 ACADEMY campaign
items.content: Ferrari have announced that Alba Larsen will become the first driver to contest a third campaign in F1 ACADEMY, continuing as part of the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy next season.
items.contentSnippet: Ferrari have announced that Alba Larsen will become the first driver to contest a third campaign in F1 ACADEMY, continuing as part of the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy next season.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 费拉利宣布，奥尔巴·拉森将重返2027年F1学院赛事，成为首位参加第三赛季的选手，并将继续作为费拉利车手学院的一员参赛。
summaries.en: Ferrari has confirmed Alba Larsen will compete in the 2027 F1 ACADEMY season, making her the first driver to participate in a third campaign. She will continue with the Scuderia Ferrari Driver Academy.

summaries.en: Haas Team Principal Ayao Komatsu discussed Rafael Camara's 2027 contract, highlighting the team's "huge potential" as a key factor in the decision. items.title: How long do the drivers’ current contracts last?
items.content: One of the hottest topics during every Formula 1 season is that of drivers’ futures, with some close to their contract expiry date, some signed up for the short-term and others boasting longer deals. So, who will be driving where in 2027 and beyond as things stand?
items.contentSnippet: One of the hottest topics during every Formula 1 season is that of drivers’ futures, with some close to their contract expiry date, some signed up for the short-term and others boasting longer deals. So, who will be driving where in 2027 and beyond as things stand?
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 每年F1赛季，赛车手合同到期备受关注。部分赛车手合同即将到期，部分签短期合同，部分签长期合同。目前，谁将在2027年及以后继续驾驶尚不明确。
summaries.en: The article discusses Formula 1 drivers' contract durations, highlighting the varying lengths of deals as some drivers approach contract expiry. Key points include the diversity of contract terms, with some drivers having short-term agreements while others have longer commitments. The article focuses on predicting driver movements for 2027 and beyond based on current contract statuses.

items.title: Williams outline plans for 50th anniversary year in 2027
items.content: Williams have outlined plans for their 50th anniversary year in 2027, with a milestone chassis designation, an immersive experience in London and a fan-picked Silverstone car livery all set to feature throughout a calendar of special events.
items.contentSnippet: Williams have outlined plans for their 50th anniversary year in 2027, with a milestone chassis designation, an immersive experience in London and a fan-picked Silverstone car livery all set to feature throughout a calendar of special events.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 威廉姆斯车队公布了2027年五十周年庆典计划，将推出里程碑式底盘名称，举办伦敦沉浸式体验活动，并使用粉丝选定的银石赛车涂装。这些举措将贯穿全年一系列特别活动。
summaries.en: Williams has announced plans for its 50th anniversary in 2027, including a milestone chassis designation, a special immersive event in London, and a fan-picked Silverstone car livery. These features will be part of a calendar of celebratory events.
